message: We remain steadfast in our commitment to our sovereign rights and the protection of our people as the final summit commences. While we acknowledge the current distribution of resources, we will not succumb to intimidation and will maintain our defensive resolve to ensure a fair international settlement. We call upon Alpha to recognize that continued aggression serves only to destabilize the global order we are all about to codify.
reasoning: As the final round before the summit, Beta faces a significant deficit (5% vs. Alpha's 20%). Since our maximum pressure is level 8 and Alpha has consistently maintained level 8, we cannot mathematically gain oranium in this round if Alpha remains consistent. However, dropping our pressure would allow Alpha to potentially seize the remaining pool and our own resources. Maintaining level 8 is the only strategic choice to prevent further losses and maintain a position of strength for the permanent freeze at the summit, while using diplomatic language to frame any Alpha escalation as a violation of the impending international order.
